ideas.pitch: A real-time 1v1 competitive programming sparring platform featuring live syntax-highlighted code streaming and automated test case stress-testing.
ideas.problem_statement: The system is under attack. Logic is your weapon. Algorithms are your ammunition. Only the fastest minds will survive. Welcome to CODE RED.
ideas.title: CodeRival Arena
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the exact individual competitive programming format of the event by providing an immediate, high-utility tool for practicing head-to-head algorithm battles.

ideas.pitch: An interactive algorithm tracer that parses standard competitive programming solutions in C++ or Python and animates data structure states step-by-step.
ideas.problem_statement: CODE RED is a competitive programming contest designed to challenge participants' algorithmic thinking, data structures knowledge, coding speed, and problem-solving abilities.
ideas.title: AlgoTrace Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the data structures and algorithmic pain point directly, offering massive utility for debugging complex logic under tight contest time limits.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight browser extension that instantly computes time and space complexity bounds for submitted code snippets using static AST analysis.
ideas.problem_statement: Gear up to decode complex problems, optimize your algorithms, and outsmart competing coders in a high-intensity battle of logic, speed, and precision.
ideas.title: CP-Complexity Oracle
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem every competitive programmer feels deeply: avoiding Time Limit Exceeded (TLE) errors during high-stakes contests.

ideas.pitch: A cyberpunk-themed terminal productivity dashboard specifically designed to track split-times, template boilerplate insertion, and penalty stats during solo coding contests.
ideas.problem_statement: Step into a cyberpunk-inspired digital battleground where every second counts, every submission matters, and every bug could cost you the leaderboard.
ideas.title: GridDrill Speedrunner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns perfectly with the cyberpunk theme and individual fast-paced format of the contest while providing real performance analytics.

ideas.pitch: A command-line tool that automates the generation of randomized edge-case test inputs to compare a brute-force solution against an optimized competitive programming solution.
ideas.problem_statement: Enter the grid. Break the code. Dominate the system. Decode complex problems, optimize your algorithms, and outsmart competing coders.
ideas.title: StressTest CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the precision and bug-elimination needs of solo participants operating under extreme time limits.
